basic_info.description: ***OPEN HOUSE SUNDAY JANUARY 19  1-4PM*** Located just off 24th Street, this duplex presents a unique opportunity for investors or homeowners looking to put their personal touch on a property. Located in Noe Valley, this fixer-upper is brimming with potential. Each unit offers spacious layouts, with laminated floors and generous room sizes. Both kitchens and bathrooms are in need of updates, providing the perfect canvas for renovation enthusiasts. The building requires updates, including new fixtures, and repairs. Outside, the backyard offers ample space for landscaping or potential outdoor living areas. With a little vision and effort, this duplex can be transformed into a beautiful, income-generating property or a fantastic multi-family home. Don’t miss the chance to make this property your own and unlock its true potential!
